definitions.explanation: A person traveling on a vehicle such as a train, airplane, or ship. A formal term used in transportation and official contexts.

examples.japanese: {旅客|りょかく}が{搭乗|とうじょう}を{待|ま}っている。
examples.english: The passengers are waiting to board.

examples.japanese: この{路線|ろせん}の{旅客|りょかく}{数|すう}は{年々|ねんねん}{増|ふ}えている。
examples.english: The number of passengers on this route is increasing year by year.

examples.japanese: {旅客|りょかく}ターミナルの{改修|かいしゅう}{工事|こうじ}が{来月|らいげつ}から{始|はじ}まる{予定|よてい}だ。
examples.english: Renovation work on the passenger terminal is scheduled to begin next month.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal, written-register word used mainly in transportation contexts. Everyday conversation would use {乗客|じょうきゃく} (passenger) or {お{客|きゃく}さん} instead. Often appears as a compound modifier.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {旅客機|りょかくき}: passenger aircraft
- {旅客|りょかく}ターミナル: passenger terminal
- {旅客船|りょかくせん}: passenger ship
- {旅客|りょかく}{数|すう}: number of passengers

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {乗客|じょうきゃく}: passenger (general, everyday)
- {旅行者|りょこうしゃ}: traveler (person on a trip)
- {搭乗者|とうじょうしゃ}: person boarding (aircraft)
